residency_notes: Baseten does not store model inputs or outputs by default for synchronous inference. Regional environments require Baseten configuration and expose a regional endpoint that keeps inference within the designated region; standard endpoints do not provide that guarantee. Async inputs are temporarily stored until processed, while outputs are not stored.
prompt_training_notes: Baseten says model inputs and outputs are not stored by default for synchronous inference. Async inputs are temporarily stored until processed, outputs are not stored, and account-configured caching or saved data can create separate retention paths.
